subject.title: fix(streaming): preserve paragraph separators across block-streamed deliveries [AI-assisted]

question: Should this streaming contract be completed with explicit boundary metadata, a reserve-width size split, or an intentionally partial text-only repair?
rationale: The code and contributor discussion show the current text-only approach cannot preserve every near-limit separator while also respecting maxChars and coalesced seams, and two open PRs now compete for the same contract choice.

options.title: Choose a complete shared boundary contract
options.body: Require one consolidated PR to preserve paragraph boundaries across both in-budget and near-maxChars splits before merge.

options.title: Accept the partial text-only repair
options.body: Maintainers can knowingly land the common-case improvement while leaving the near-limit boundary documented on the canonical issue.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Close or pause the competing PRs until a maintainer-owned design for boundary metadata or reserve-width splitting is ready.

recommendation.title: Choose a complete shared boundary contract
recommendation.body: Require one consolidated PR to preserve paragraph boundaries across both in-budget and near-maxChars splits before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the current chunker, subscriber, coalescer, and earlier block-streaming hardening path.
